"""Gated alias checks against the actual qualified parent source."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import difflib
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata')
W = G / '.worktree/feat-layer-major-bulk-upload-20261013'
P = G / '.worktree/feat-layer-major-phase-cycle-20261013'
C = G / '.worktree/feat-layer-major-phase4k-20261013'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase_full_lint_final_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def dump(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')


def findings(value, root):
    result = []
    for line in value.splitlines():
        line = line.replace(str(root) + '/', '')
        match = re.match(r'(.+?):(\d+)(?::\d+|,\d+)?: (warning|error): (.+)', line)
        if match:
            path, number, severity, message = match.groups()
            result.append((path, int(number), severity, message))
            continue
        match = re.match(r'(.+?):(\d+)(?::\d+)?: (MD\d+ .+)', line)
        if match:
            path, number, message = match.groups()
            result.append((path, int(number), 'markdown', message))
            continue
        match = re.match(r'(CMakeLists\.txt):(\d+)(?:,\d+)?: (\[C\d+\].+)', line)
        if match:
            path, number, message = match.groups()
            result.append((path, int(number), 'cmake', message))
            continue
        match = re.match(r'(.+?):(\d+): (.+ ==> .+)', line)
        if match:
            path, number, message = match.groups()
            result.append((path, int(number), 'codespell', message))
    return result


def key(row):
    path, number, severity, message = row
    # Same class and unchanged padding byte counts are an existing finding.
    # Keep full original messages; only the suggested field-order tail varies.
    if '[clang-analyzer-optin.performance.Padding]' in message:
        message = message.split('Optimal fields order:')[0] + '[clang-analyzer-optin.performance.Padding]'
    return path, number, severity, message


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    build_path = B / 'main-layer-major-bulk-full-build-root-v1/record.json'
    baseline_path = B / 'main-layer-major-phase4k-full-lints-root-v2/record.json'
    build, baseline_record = load(build_path), load(baseline_path)
    assert build['passed'] and build['complete'] and not build['active']
    assert not baseline_record['active']
    out = B / 'main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    env = dict(baseline_record['environment'])
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[], evidence={},
             environment=env, source_pins=build['source_pins'], lints_qualified=False, gpu_executed=False,
             no_checks_disabled=True, baseline_receipt_sha256=m.sha(baseline_path),
             build_receipt_sha256=m.sha(build_path), retained_original_failed_status=True, actual_parent_baseline=True)

    def save():
        dump(out / 'record.json', r)

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands

    def run(label, argv, cwd=W, allowed=(0,)):
        print('OWNED SOURCE CHECK ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, cwd, wall=1200, cpu=9600, rss_cap=6 << 30,
                            text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        stdout, stderr = so.read_text(), se.read_text()
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        if 'lints' in label:
            assert 'skipped (' not in stdout + stderr
            assert '== gitleaks: a possible secret' not in stdout + stderr
            assert 'Error: Could not' not in stdout + stderr
            assert 'Error: Failed' not in stdout + stderr
        return stdout + '\n' + stderr

    try:
        r['baseline_head'] = run('baseline-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], C).strip()
        run('baseline-descends-qualified4k', ['git', 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', 'db088ff24e67e6a4566566dfc4762c63c55bf343', 'HEAD'], C)
        assert baseline_record['passed'] and baseline_record['complete'] and baseline_record['lints_qualified']
        assert not baseline_record['novel_findings']
        assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in baseline_record['commands'])
        assert len(build['source_pins']) == 22 and len(baseline_record['source_pins']) == 18
        assert all(m.sha(C / name) == sha for name, sha in baseline_record['source_pins'].items())
        extra = ['CMakeLists.txt', 'include/strata/core/expert_source.hpp', 'src/core/expert_source.cpp']
        new = 'include/strata/core/layer_bulk_layout.hpp'
        assert set(build['source_pins']) == set(baseline_record['source_pins']) | set(extra) | {new}
        assert run('parent-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], P).strip() == '1a7b95e336c4dda84e6beef544fe5acd3fabdc92'
        old_text = {name: (C / name).read_text() for name in baseline_record['source_pins']}
        for name in extra:
            original = run('parent-source-' + str(extra.index(name)), ['git', 'show', '8b48d17c99b70d32781f9f5b056602a598a37b1c:' + name], P)
            assert original == (P / name).read_text().strip()
            old_text[name] = (P / name).read_text()
        current_text = {name: (W / name).read_text() for name in build['source_pins']}
        assert all(m.sha(W / name) == sha for name, sha in build['source_pins'].items())
        before = [tuple(row) for row in baseline_record['candidate_findings']]
        r['reused_qualified_baseline'] = dict(path=str(baseline_path), sha256=m.sha(baseline_path),
            source_pins=baseline_record['source_pins'], reason='Reuse qualified4K18-file NoNew proof; fresh baseline checks on three unchanged actual8b48 files; new header has no allowed baseline findings.')
        env['STRATA_LINT_BUILD'] = str(P / 'build/free')
        extra_output = run('parent-extra-source-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *extra], P, allowed=(0, 1))
        extra_rows = findings(extra_output, P)
        # Fresh parent diagnostics can reference included files: compose parent->4K line maps.
        for path, line, severity, message in extra_rows:
            if path in old_text and path not in extra:
                blocks = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=(P/path).read_text().splitlines(), b=old_text[path].splitlines(), autojunk=False).get_matching_blocks()
                pm = {block.a+i+1:block.b+i+1 for block in blocks for i in range(block.size)}
                if line not in pm:
                    continue
                line = pm[line]
            before.append((path, line, severity, message))
        r['actual_parent_extra_source_pins'] = {name:m.sha(P/name) for name in extra}
        r['actual_parent_selected_source_identical'] = True
        env['STRATA_LINT_BUILD'] = str(W / 'build/free')
        mappings = {}
        for name in old_text.keys() & current_text.keys():
            blocks = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=old_text[name].splitlines(), b=current_text[name].splitlines(), autojunk=False).get_matching_blocks()
            mappings[name] = {block.a+i+1:block.b+i+1 for block in blocks for i in range(block.size)}
        allowed = Counter()
        for path, line, severity, message in before:
            mapped = mappings[path].get(line) if path in mappings else line
            if mapped is not None:
                allowed[key((path, mapped, severity, message))] += 1
        after_output = run('candidate-full-source-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *build['source_pins']], allowed=(0, 1))
        after = findings(after_output, W)
        r['novel_findings'] = []
        for row in after:
            if allowed[key(row)]:
                allowed[key(row)] -= 1
            else:
                r['novel_findings'].append(row)
        r['baseline_findings'], r['candidate_findings'] = before, after
        r['padding_comparison_policy'] = 'Existing identical padding byte count/checker/severity/mapped location; keep full original messages'
        save()
        assert not r['novel_findings'], 'Inspect new findings; no suppression allowed'
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        assert all(m.sha(C/name)==sha for name,sha in baseline_record['source_pins'].items())
        assert all(m.sha(P/name)==sha for name,sha in r['actual_parent_extra_source_pins'].items())
        assert all(m.sha(W/name)==sha for name,sha in build['source_pins'].items())
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, lints_qualified=True,
            scope='All22 optin bulk source files, all tools enabled, mapped qualified4K18-file proof plus fresh actual8b48 extra-three-file baseline; no suppressions; no GPU/model run')
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback'] = traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'lints_qualified', 'novel_findings')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
